applies_to: Setra FLEX wall-mounted room pressure and environmental monitors (FLEX-RM monitor-only and FLEX-RC room control) covering up to three rooms.
summary: The Setra FLEX is a touch-screen room pressure and environmental monitor that watches up to three rooms with six parameters each (pressure, temperature, humidity, ACH and two user-defined). It talks BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP and exposes the room readings, alarm states, limits and almost all setup as objects; each room parameter can come from an on-board input or be read from another BACnet device. The FLEX-RC version can also control equipment with PI loops or BACnet setpoint overrides.
notes: Access is taken from the list's Writable column. AI, BI and MI objects are marked writable only when out of service; they are shown here as read-only.
The list gives no engineering units; room values follow the units of their configured source (BV 82-99 choose local or BACnet-source units).
Analog input and alarm-limit values are bounded by each object's min-pres-value and max-pres-value.
Room parameters, alarm limits and source settings repeat for Room 1, 2 and 3; profile settings repeat for profiles 1-4.
MV 49 and MV 50 are both printed as "Room Profile 3 Control Preset"; names are kept as printed.
The Loop rows print "Loop 1" to "Loop 4" in the type/instance column (without the hyphen the other rows use); they are read here as Loop instances 1-4.

integration.summary: Read the room pressure, temperature and humidity AIs and the per-room and system alarm state MIs; map the door inputs if used. Room standby (BV 72-74) and the active room profile (MV 19-21) can be written from the BMS to switch modes such as occupied and unoccupied. On FLEX-RC units the four setpoint controls have preset A/B setpoints and limits in AV 177-206.

minimum_points.name: Room 1 Temperature
minimum_points.why: Room 1 temperature, from its configured source

minimum_points.name: Room 1 Humidity
minimum_points.why: Room 1 humidity, from its configured source

integration.enable: Room 1-3 Standby (BV 72-74) put a room in standby, and Room 1-3 Room Profile (MV 19-21) pick which of the four profiles (alarm limits and control presets) is active.
integration.remote_sensors: Each room parameter has a source selector (MV 1-18, 6 = BACnet). With BACnet selected, the FLEX reads the value from another device set by the matching device instance, object instance and object type objects (AV 141-176, MV 55-72). The four setpoint controls point at external BACnet setpoint objects set by AV 183/184, 191/192, 199/200 and 207/208 (device and object instance).
setup: BACnet IP uses IPv4 with static IP or DHCP; BACnet MS/TP runs at up to 76.8 kbps (Setra data sheet and specification guide).
The device object is listed as Device-4194302 with an instance range of 0-4194303, where 4194303 means unconfigured.
Setra states that anything set up on the touch screen can also be set over BACnet, except passwords, the device ID and read-only items.
gotchas: Most of the list is configuration (limits, delays, display, sources); avoid writing those objects cyclically from the BMS.
MV 90-93 set the BACnet priority used for the setpoint overrides; check they do not clash with the BMS command priority.
Execute BACnet Time Sync? (BV 7) must be 1 for the unit to accept BACnet time synchronization.
Operator Password (CSV 18) is writable over BACnet; restrict write access on the BMS side.
